parsed.rationale: All 15 participating records are unnamed extensions (name: "") on SwiftUI's `View` type spread across unrelated packages — WXUI, Wallpaper, PartyHorn, PlayerHeaderView, MusicShareKit, and app:iOS. The cluster was surfaced by a name-collision query, but the collision is on the empty-string name of anonymous `extension` declarations, not on any shared project-local type or protocol. Each extension lives in a domain-specific file (e.g., `GlassEffect+Compatibility.swift`, `PlaybackBlendMode.swift`, `WipeDownRevealModifier.swift`, `StatusBarStyleModifier.swift`) and almost certainly extends `View` with unrelated, file-scoped helpers. The `fields_or_signature` list is empty for every record, so there is no evidence of shared members that could be consolidated. Consolidating these extensions would couple unrelated UI concerns across package boundaries without any structural benefit.
